lead._comment: No backend required. Uses FormSubmit (https://formsubmit.co) AJAX to forward submissions to the email. The FIRST submission triggers a one-time activation email that the owner must confirm. If FormSubmit is unreachable, the site falls back to opening the visitor's mail client (mailto).
